checkpoint.title: Route 6's grass until Lt. Surge is winnable, then through the open beams to him
notes: Wild battles on Route 6 until the sim beats Lt. Surge half the time: with Dig, 47% at Lv28 and 51% at Lv29, so a lead the gym's trainers have brought to Lv29 passes at once, and a Lv28 one after a level. The grass nearest the city is Route 6's south patch (13..16, 30..33); Picnicker Isabelle (13, 32) faces west over (10..12, 32), on the way north from the city, so the walk goes along Jeff's row 33 (he is beaten) to the wall (7, 33), up to row 31 and east along it onto the patch's west edge, (13, 31), above Isabelle, out of her line. Back to the nurse the same way. All that is skipped when the lead, read in the Center, passes already. Then the tree, the gym, whose trainers stand where the map has them, beaten, and whose beams stay off (FLAG_FOUND_BOTH_VERMILION_GYM_SWITCHES): up column 5 to below Lt. Surge, and saved there.
